title: The Salt of the Sundered Sea
author: Mirabel Thackeray
blurb: Wendell Eastwick, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
